title: At phone width the line window shows the same Title and Description words
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an open work order, work order 1, with a line, line 1, that has a title and a description.
  • Use a phone, or a desktop browser window narrowed to 600 pixels wide or less.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Line.
  2. Close the New Line window without saving.
  3. Click line 1's title.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Line window opens over work order 1.
  • The first field reads "Title" with the grey prompt "What are you doing?" in the box.
  • The second field reads "Description" with the grey prompt "Why are you doing it?" in the box.

Step 2:

  • The New Line window closes and work order 1's Lines tab shows again.

Step 3:

  • The Edit Line window opens for line 1.
  • Its fields read "Title" and "Description" and show line 1's saved title and description.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 15 (14 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10130 (Story 1, The Work Order Line Dialog)

  • Form Factor: “The work order line dialog is a core work-order surface and is used on a phone by technicians, so it carries a mobile variant already. This spec changes two labels and two placeholders inside it and nothing else: the mobile variant shows the same words, in the same fields, with no separate design work owed. Every other surface here is either a downloaded file or a background sync, neither of which has a form factor.”
  • S1-R1: “The first field is labeled exactly "Title", with no asterisk.”
  • S1-R2: “The second field is labeled exactly "Description".”
  • S1-R3: “The Title box carries the placeholder "What are you doing?" and the Description box carries "Why are you doing it?". Placeholder text shows while the box is empty and disappears as soon as there is a value. The labels Title and Description always sit at the top of their boxes, empty or filled, with the placeholder underneath; in production the label sat inside the empty box. This is the one layout change in the dialog.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-11257, and bug SV-11850 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10130, Nemanja Djuric, 8 Oct 2026 (Ready for QA testing): “Phone width (≤ 600px): the same labels, prompts and message.”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.
